title: Understanding the organisation and its context
summary: Identify internal and external issues relevant to the ISMS purpose.
typical_evidence: Context analysis (issues register; SWOT or PESTLE)

title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
summary: Identify interested parties and their relevant requirements including legal and contractual ones.
typical_evidence: Interested parties register with requirements

title: Scope of the ISMS
summary: Define and document the boundaries and applicability of the ISMS.
typical_evidence: ISMS scope statement

title: Information security management system
summary: Establish implement maintain and continually improve the ISMS.
typical_evidence: ISMS manual or overview; process map

title: Leadership and commitment
summary: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment to the ISMS.
typical_evidence: Management review minutes; signed policy; resource approvals

title: Policy
summary: Top management establishes an information security policy suited to the organisation.
typical_evidence: Approved information security policy; communication record

title: Roles responsibilities and authorities
summary: Top management assigns and communicates ISMS roles and authorities.
typical_evidence: RACI or roles document; appointment of ISMS owner

title: Actions to address risks and opportunities - general
summary: Plan actions to address risks and opportunities to the ISMS.
typical_evidence: ISMS risk and opportunity plan

title: Information security risk assessment
summary: Define and apply a repeatable risk assessment process with risk criteria and owners.
typical_evidence: Risk assessment methodology; risk assessment results; risk register

title: Information security risk treatment
summary: Select treatment options and controls; produce a Statement of Applicability and a risk treatment plan approved by risk owners.
typical_evidence: Statement of Applicability; risk treatment plan; risk owner approvals

title: Information security objectives and planning
summary: Set measurable security objectives and plan how to achieve them.
typical_evidence: Objectives with measures; tracking records

title: Planning of changes
summary: Carry out changes to the ISMS in a planned manner.
typical_evidence: ISMS change records

title: Resources
summary: Determine and provide resources needed for the ISMS.
typical_evidence: Budget or resource plan; staffing

title: Competence
summary: Ensure people doing ISMS work are competent and keep evidence of competence.
typical_evidence: Competence matrix; training and certification records

title: Awareness
summary: People are aware of the policy their contribution and consequences of non-conformance.
typical_evidence: Awareness training completion; policy acknowledgements

title: Communication
summary: Determine internal and external communications relevant to the ISMS.
typical_evidence: Communication plan

title: Documented information
summary: Create update and control documented information required by the ISMS.
typical_evidence: Document control procedure; document register with versions and owners

title: Operational planning and control
summary: Plan implement and control processes needed to meet requirements including outsourced processes.
typical_evidence: Operating procedures; outsourced process controls

title: Information security risk assessment (operation)
summary: Perform risk assessments at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
typical_evidence: Dated risk assessment results for the period

title: Information security risk treatment (operation)
summary: Implement the risk treatment plan and keep results.
typical_evidence: Risk treatment status records

title: Monitoring measurement analysis and evaluation
summary: Decide what to monitor and measure and evaluate ISMS performance.
typical_evidence: Metrics or KPI reports

title: Internal audit
summary: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals with an audit programme and impartial auditors.
typical_evidence: Internal audit programme; internal audit report; auditor independence

title: Management review
summary: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals with defined inputs and outputs.
typical_evidence: Management review minutes covering required inputs and decisions

title: Continual improvement
summary: Continually improve the suitability adequacy and effectiveness of the ISMS.
typical_evidence: Improvement log; corrective action outcomes

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
summary: React to nonconformities; find root cause; take and review corrective action.
typical_evidence: Corrective action register with root cause and effectiveness review

title: Policies for information security
summary: Define approve publish communicate and review a security policy and topic-specific policies.
typical_evidence: Policy set with approvals and review dates; acknowledgements

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
summary: Define and allocate security roles and responsibilities.
typical_evidence: Roles document; job descriptions

title: Segregation of duties
summary: Separate conflicting duties and areas of responsibility.
typical_evidence: SoD matrix; role assignments

title: Management responsibilities
summary: Management requires staff to apply security per policies.
typical_evidence: Policy acknowledgements; management communications

title: Contact with authorities
summary: Establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.
typical_evidence: Authority contact list (e.g. CERT-In; Data Protection Board; police)

title: Contact with special interest groups
summary: Maintain contact with security forums and professional groups.
typical_evidence: Memberships; mailing list subscriptions

title: Threat intelligence
summary: Collect and analyse information on security threats.
typical_evidence: Threat intel sources; advisories reviewed

title: Information security in project management
summary: Integrate security into project management.
typical_evidence: Project templates with security review; design review records

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
summary: Keep an inventory of information and assets with owners.
typical_evidence: Asset inventory with owners (devices; cloud resources; SaaS)

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
summary: Define and implement rules for acceptable use.
typical_evidence: Acceptable use policy; acknowledgements

title: Return of assets
summary: People return organisational assets on leaving or change of role.
typical_evidence: Offboarding checklist with asset return for sampled leavers

title: Classification of information
summary: Classify information by confidentiality integrity availability and stakeholder needs.
typical_evidence: Classification policy; classified data inventory

title: Labelling of information
summary: Label information according to the classification scheme.
typical_evidence: Labelling procedure; examples

title: Information transfer
summary: Have rules and agreements for transferring information internally and externally.
typical_evidence: Information transfer policy; TLS and sharing settings

title: Access control
summary: Set rules for physical and logical access based on business and security needs.
typical_evidence: Access control policy; IdP configuration

title: Identity management
summary: Manage the full life cycle of identities.
typical_evidence: Joiner-mover-leaver procedure; IdP user export

title: Authentication information
summary: Control allocation and management of authentication information.
typical_evidence: Password policy; MFA enforcement; secrets management

title: Access rights
summary: Provision review modify and remove access rights per policy.
typical_evidence: Access requests; periodic access reviews; deprovisioning records

title: Information security in supplier relationships
summary: Manage security risks from suppliers' products and services.
typical_evidence: Supplier security policy; vendor inventory

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
summary: Agree security requirements with each supplier.
typical_evidence: Contracts or DPAs with security clauses

title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
summary: Manage security risks in the ICT product and service supply chain.
typical_evidence: Dependency and SBOM management; vendor reviews

title: Monitoring review and change management of supplier services
summary: Regularly monitor review and evaluate supplier security and changes.
typical_evidence: Annual vendor reviews; vendor SOC reports reviewed

title: Information security for use of cloud services
summary: Define processes to acquire use manage and exit cloud services securely.
typical_evidence: Cloud security policy; shared responsibility mapping

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
summary: Plan and prepare for incident management with defined roles and processes.
typical_evidence: Incident response plan; on-call roster

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
summary: Assess events and decide whether they are incidents.
typical_evidence: Triage criteria; event and incident tickets

title: Response to information security incidents
summary: Respond to incidents per documented procedures.
typical_evidence: Incident tickets with response timeline

title: Learning from information security incidents
summary: Use incident knowledge to strengthen controls.
typical_evidence: Postmortems with actions

title: Collection of evidence
summary: Have procedures to identify collect and preserve evidence of security events.
typical_evidence: Forensic evidence procedure; log retention

title: Information security during disruption
summary: Maintain security at an appropriate level during disruption.
typical_evidence: BCP covering security during disruption

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
summary: Plan implement maintain and test ICT readiness for continuity objectives.
typical_evidence: DR plan with RTO and RPO; DR test records

title: Legal statutory regulatory and contractual requirements
summary: Identify document and keep up to date legal and contractual security requirements.
typical_evidence: Legal and regulatory register

title: Intellectual property rights
summary: Implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
typical_evidence: Software licence inventory; IP clauses in contracts

title: Protection of records
summary: Protect records from loss destruction falsification and unauthorised access.
typical_evidence: Records retention schedule; access restrictions

title: Privacy and protection of PII
summary: Identify and meet requirements for privacy and PII protection.
typical_evidence: Privacy policy; records of processing; DPAs

title: Independent review of information security
summary: Review the approach to information security independently at planned intervals.
typical_evidence: Independent or internal audit report; penetration test report

title: Compliance with policies rules and standards for information security
summary: Regularly review compliance with security policies and standards.
typical_evidence: Compliance checks; control self-assessments

title: Documented operating procedures
summary: Document operating procedures and make them available.
typical_evidence: Runbooks; SOPs

title: Screening
summary: Do background checks on candidates before joining and as appropriate.
typical_evidence: Background check records for sampled hires

title: Terms and conditions of employment
summary: Employment agreements state security responsibilities.
typical_evidence: Offer letter or contract template with security clauses; signed samples

title: Information security awareness education and training
summary: Staff receive appropriate security awareness and training with regular updates.
typical_evidence: Training completion records for the period

title: Disciplinary process
summary: Have a formal communicated disciplinary process for security violations.
typical_evidence: Disciplinary policy

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
summary: Security duties that stay valid after leaving are defined and enforced.
typical_evidence: Exit checklist; confidentiality reminders at exit

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
summary: Use NDAs reflecting protection needs; review them.
typical_evidence: NDA template; signed NDAs for sampled staff and contractors

title: Remote working
summary: Implement security measures for remote work.
typical_evidence: Remote working policy; VPN or zero-trust; MDM

title: Information security event reporting
summary: Provide a way for people to report observed security events promptly.
typical_evidence: Reporting channel; reported event tickets

title: Physical security perimeters
summary: Define and use security perimeters to protect areas with information and assets.
typical_evidence: Office floor plan; cloud provider report (inherited)

title: Physical entry
summary: Protect secure areas with entry controls and access points.
typical_evidence: Badge access logs; visitor log

title: Securing offices rooms and facilities
summary: Design and implement physical security for offices and facilities.
typical_evidence: Office security measures; photos or landlord documents

title: Physical security monitoring
summary: Continuously monitor premises for unauthorised physical access.
typical_evidence: CCTV or alarm records; cloud provider report

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
summary: Protect against natural disasters and other physical threats.
typical_evidence: Cloud provider report; office fire safety

title: Working in secure areas
summary: Define measures for working in secure areas.
typical_evidence: Secure area rules

title: Clear desk and clear screen
summary: Define and enforce clear desk and clear screen rules.
typical_evidence: Policy; MDM screen lock setting

title: Equipment siting and protection
summary: Site equipment securely and protect it.

title: Security of assets off-premises
summary: Protect assets used off site.
typical_evidence: MDM disk encryption report; laptop policy

title: Storage media
summary: Manage storage media through acquisition use transport and disposal.
typical_evidence: Media handling procedure; USB restrictions

title: Supporting utilities
summary: Protect facilities from power and utility failures.

title: Cabling security
summary: Protect power and data cables from interception and damage.
typical_evidence: Cloud provider report; office cabling

title: Equipment maintenance
summary: Maintain equipment correctly.
typical_evidence: Maintenance records; device patch status

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
summary: Wipe or destroy storage before disposal or re-use.
typical_evidence: Device wipe or disposal certificates

title: User endpoint devices

title: Access to source code

title: Secure authentication
summary: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures.
typical_evidence: MFA and SSO enforcement exports

title: Capacity management
summary: Monitor and adjust resource use to current and expected capacity.
typical_evidence: Autoscaling config; capacity dashboards

title: Protection against malware
summary: Implement malware protection supported by user awareness.

summary: Establish document monitor and review secure configurations.

title: Information deletion

summary: Synchronise clocks to approved time sources.

title: Installation of software on operational systems
summary: Manage software installation on operational systems.

title: Networks security
summary: Secure manage and control networks and devices.

title: Security of network services
summary: Identify implement and monitor security of network services.

summary: Identify specify and approve security requirements for applications.

summary: Establish and apply secure engineering principles.
